name: One Week At Birchwood University
source:
"A game about being trans, gay, and happy.

Ashley is a recent college graduate driving to visit her brother during his spring break. When she arrives, she's met with a house full of people, and a slightly drunk brother. There she meets three girls who quickly take a liking to her, and invite her to join in on their spring break plans. Choose who to spend your time with and get to know your new friends!" from itch.io game page
translation:
一款關於跨性別、同性戀與幸福的遊戲。

剛從大學畢業的阿什莉趁兄弟放春假，開車去看望他。抵達後，她看見屋裡擠滿了人，兄弟也有些微醺。她在那裡結識了三個女孩，對方很快便喜歡上她，並邀請她加入春假的活動計劃。選擇與誰共度時光，認識你的新朋友吧！

[摘自itch.io遊戲頁面]
